...every Story has to have an end...”

The Good Left The City: the conclusion to Alix: A MONITOR Story. 

The shady organisation known as Cygnus is closing the net on two rogue agents from different agencies: James Carter and Alix McClair. 

Helped by an Artificial Intelligence named Sundry who has greater plans for both of them, the final years of the MONITOR universe will unfold to the end of everything.

The short story will be released soon for free! Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: An update...
notes.content:
Hello all!

It's been a while hasn't it?

As you may all well have known, Nascent State was to be the next DLC for MONITOR.

Sadly, things have not been as smooth as I would like with two jobs in the games industry. Yes, you read that right: two! That's a great thing for me but for the DLC...not so much.

As I look more in to Nascent State, I realised that the direction it was taking wasn't the one I wanted. The problem was...it was not very fun and it's a disservice to everyone: my voice actors, my composer, me and the people that play it.

So for now, Nascent State has stopped development...but I can assure you, all the stuff that's been done will not go to waste. You will find out about Beatrix Nowak and what happened to Lana Remley that fateful day in the Monitorverse...but it will be in a different guise.

Thanks for all being awesome though; appreciate ya!

Dave (DNT Games)

notes.title: Nascent State: A MONITOR Story - the Next DLC
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30530657/368d167c2282785600b89b24a12607874342fa2d.jpg[/img]

The new game! Nascent State: A MONITOR Story - A smaller story of the MONITOR experience following the life of a new character...

"Where else but to start at the end?

But what end you may ask?

Darker forces lurk within the world, hiding with power that most normal people can't even comprehend. The power to make people vanish within the blink of an eye. It is a time where things are prepared to change; but at a cost.

You are Beatrix Nowak; Detective of Miami PD whom is the best at her job - over-tired and underpaid; Nowak can see things that others can't.

A double murder has occurred at Keel Marina - two people whose lives were snuffed out in their prime. You have the opportunity to relive one of the most horrific stories of the MONITOR lore and you can change the course of events to make things better...or ultimately a lot worse.

An adventure with many varied endings; what could you do if you had another chance?"

notes.title: V1.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello all!

Wow, did I have a lot of bugs to fix. Special thanks to Taco Chip for finding a lot of them but the new patch is coming in the next hour or so. Make sure to update so you can take advantage.

[B]Bug Fixes[/b]

- A way to stop clicking the Events board once you're looking at the Dolos statue on Day Two.
- Day Three Billiard Room Subs fixed.
- Sundry Disk now spawns properly on Day One. A new disk has also been added to the Harrowing ending. So all six are accessible. Remember you need all eight documents before Sundry appears.
- Load screens fixed in certain circumstances.
- Options remember your choices once you've clicked them for the first time. When you reload, however, these will reset but it is easy to put them back the way you want them. This will be fixed in future releases but isn't important right now.


[B]Functionality Added[/b]

- A way to change from Window to Fullscreen mode in the options.
- A new hidden part that was going to be a secret...but I think Taco Chip may have rumbled me too soon...so it's in now!

[b]Functionality Removed[/b]

- The Pause Menu in game has been removed as this was added way late in to the final builds. Sadly, it never really worked and it just destroys the true vibe of real-time that the game needs. So you can't pause the game now; once you're in - you're in! Sorry!

[b]Other Notes from Comments made[/b]

You can glitch the game out by clicking too quick between screens and it technically was not meant to be played too fast. However, I am aware of that now but I've got to think of a way to stop it in future. It's on the horizon though but I need to think it through...so don't be too fast!

The actual option to change what effects on screen is something I can look in to but isn't too important right now. This will be some way off.

There is no red x's under the chair. That's just the chair legs.

The game won't have the names of people talking. This was something I toyed with but it butchered the idea that you are meant to figure out who is whom so it won't be added.

I know there will be other bugs but the game for now, these should make things a little better.

Thanks for playing!

ADDITIONAL CHANGE:
All endings achievement is now accessible in endings menu and final Sundry achievement is unlocked once all docs are attained in menu. There's two hidden ones (one of which is super hidden!)

notes.title: Hints!
notes.content:
Hey all!

If you're having trouble unlocking certain things in the game, take a look and see if these help...



SPOILERS AHEAD!





- The game is [i]not just the monitor room[/I]. Try clicking around. You may find things.

- one ending can only be unlocked by finding two specific items. Day one and two have a certain item which unlocks one ending in day three.

- one may require a password and username...and then carrying on to day three.

- Sundry is hiding in plain sight...but one disc may not be physical...it could be digital...

- If you have heard something you can act on but refuse to do it after going to the phone; this may have consequences.


Good luck!

New patch has been released from a lot of people telling me what is wrong. Please keep letting me know what you find so I can get the game the best it can be.

- "You Did Nothing" Ending Achievement - if you've played through and got this ending; you may have noticed you didn't get the achievement. If you go in to the Endings Menu and click the "You Did Nothing" selection; it will now unlock.
- Loading fixes. Been some issues with one of the endings not loading. This should hopefully now be fixed.

[EDIT] Additional Change:

- Some movies and sound files were not working so now you should get some tidbits for intros to certain days. Be sure to update and you'll get these new changes.

Thanks again!
